sentences.japanese: 王は人民から税を厳しく取り立てた。
sentences.english: The king exacted taxes from his people.

sentences.japanese: 王は国民に重い税を課した。
sentences.english: The king imposed heavy taxes on his people.

sentences.japanese: タバコにかけられている税は高い。
sentences.english: There is a heavy tax on tobacco.

sentences.japanese: その地域に工場を設立する外国企業には、税が大幅に減免される。
sentences.english: A generous tax break will be provided to foreign companies that set up factories in the area.

sentences.japanese: その税は農民に重くのしかかった。
sentences.english: The tax bore hard on the peasantry.
